description: GH #166. Page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/gh-165-166-295.html. oracle_goldens_match_elixir boots elixir once per oracle fixture, sequentially: 362 fixtures. Header gains 'oracle.stamp': a 64-bit FNV-1a over the .oracle.exs bytes, the .expected.txt bytes and the header args. Equal: Elixir does not run. Different or missing: run and compare; a match with a stale stamp fails asking for regen. An Elixir upgrade is caught by a check-only run that ignores stamps.
title: An oracle pair that has not changed does not boot Elixir
